svg.title: Outlook for MCP clients
svg.desc: Local agentic MCP clients and the local browser UI connect to an Outlook Connector running on this computer. Microsoft Graph's official API handles mail-data reads, attachment and MIME downloads, and verification. Outlook Web App's private, reverse-engineered API handles mail changes and inbox-rule access. Native signatures use Outlook Cloud Settings. The browser screenshot contains synthetic mailbox data. The Outlook link represents bidirectional API requests and responses.
svg.text: A local MCP server and browser UI for one Exchange Online mailbox.

g.text: Runs on your computer · starts on demand

svg.text: For local agentic clients with stdio MCP support. Hosted ChatGPT Web, Claude web chat, and Microsoft Copilot chat are not supported.
